callouts.text: **R338 is a fresh, self-inflicted cross-workflow regression.** [#34172](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34172) (merged 2026-08-10) and [#34126](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34126) (merged 2026-08-09) wire LTX-2 / FLUX.1 adaLN through a bit-exact fused LayerNorm+modulate kernel whose numerics helper emits NVIDIA PTX inline asm with the PTX-only `'f'` register constraint (`error: couldn't allocate output register for constraint 'f'`). The admission gate only checks `is_cuda`, which is **true on ROCm**, so the kernel is selected on AMD and fails to compile → unit-test failure (`test_ltx2_rms_norm_modulate.py`) on nightly kernel jobs and diffusion-server warmup hang→timeout (`flux_image_t2i`) on PR multimodal-gen jobs. `[HIGH]` cause — both commits directly add the PTX path; **disconfirming**: not yet A/B-reverted on an AMD runner. **In-flight fix**: ❌ none (precedent [#33994](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33994) gated a different model's fused kernel to NV-only — same remedy applies).

**R323 finally has a live fix again.** Yesterday's fix [#33879](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33879) was confirmed closed-unmerged; **[#34328](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34328)** ("fix AMD 2-GPU multimodal-gen partition-count abort") was opened **today 23:47 UTC** and covers both PR lanes. Until it merges, `run_suite.py` still aborts with `total_partitions (3) < standalone files (7)` before any 2-GPU diffusion test runs on `pr-test-amd` **and** `pr-test-amd-rocm720` (5th day). `[FACT]`
